batting.name: H Klaasen
batting.dismissal: c PN Mankad b Avesh Khan

batting.name: KR Mayers
batting.dismissal: c AK Markram b GD Phillips

batting.name: Q de Kock
batting.dismissal: c Abhishek Sharma b M Markande

batting.name: MP Stoinis
batting.dismissal: c Abdul Samad b Abhishek Sharma

balls.text: full toss, on the thigh, swiped into the leg side. They are running a second just in case, and a wide throw allows them to make it
yorker, just outside off, and this time they take a single, which is weird. Perhaps he thought he could push for a two, but the ball had gone straight to square leg
slower ball. The line is wide as expected, but it is on a good length, which batters love at the death. Samad lofts it over long-on for six
this time he goes at the wicket, and Samad is walking down and yorks himself up. No run again as Samad wants the strike

slower wide bouncer. Samad is looking to upper-cut, and is beaten. This time SRH have reviewed it. Samad is off his feet as he tries to play it. It is under his head at the time it goes past the popping crease, and even though the batter's feet are in the air, the on-field call is upheld
he is going wide to Samad. Low full toss, inside edge, turns down the single to short fine leg

full toss for a wicket. Hit straight down the throat of long-on. Oh plum full toss at 132ks, and Prerak Mankad takes the catch and immediately looks back to stare the at the stand, which is right behind their dugout
wide yorker. Nailed it. Also Klaasen is backing away. Dot
short ball, around off, chest high, Klaasen pulls but gets a top edge over the keeper for four

goes full and straight, but too high. On the high part of the bat as he looks to swipe at it. Called no-ball on height. LSG review it. Replays show it is touch and go on height, and because the batter is crouching a little, the third umpire has called it a fair delivery. SRH batters are not happy but the third umpire has checked the height at the moment the ball would have crossed the popping crease. They used ball tracking for it.
goes wide, but dishes up a full toss, which Samad hits high, very high, but also long enough to clear long-on
yorker, on off, dug out to long-on
goes for the wide short ball this time, and this time Samad gets a top edge on the pull that just clears short third and then spins away from him for four
another wide dot. This time a wide yorker. Samad is moving across early, which is allowing him to bowl wide
slower short ball, wide outside off, but not a wide because Samad has moved across. Left alone. Samad looks for the wide, but it is not called
short, into his body, mis-hits the pull, which is just as well because it falls just short of long-on
full and wide, and although he has missed the yorker, he concedes just the single to long-on
yorker, on the toes, dug out to deep midwicket
some grip and hold. Samad defends it back
into the pads, soft hands, into a hole in the leg side, comes back for two
interesting pitch. The odd ball has turned, but you can also hit through the line. Not overpitched, but Samad has used his reach to loft this length ball straight over his head for six
driven down to long-off this time
full, middle and leg, looks for a single to long-off, but can't beat Pandya
on a length, around off, pushed straight to extra cover
wide length ball, punched to deep cover for one
full, too full, nearly a yorker, dug out back to him
really slow and full and wide. Too wide
pushed through wide outside off, bottom edge on the cut, goes to short third
short again. Granted not quite a long hop, but it allows Klaasen to go back and pull him over wide long-on. Just seems to me he is wary of the loft, and doesn't have the pace to bowl this short
long hop. On a pitch assisting spinners, Bishnoi and Mishra haven't bowled well. Klaasen rocks back to pull it over midwicket for another six
legbreak, on off, pushed down to long-off for one
no turn this time, pushed towards deep midwicket for a single
wide on the crease, angles it into middle and leg, defended in front of off
turn again, defended back to him. Looking to play this over out
middle and off, hits the outer half of the bat with the turn
on a length, middle and off, punched down to long-off for a single
quick, on a length, middle and leg, pushed back to him
slower ball, full, outside off, driven to long-off for one
slower ball, short of a length, wide, pulled down between long-off and long-on for two
slower short ball, pulled down to deep midwicket for one
forget about finding gaps when you can skip down the track and loft him on the up for a six over mid-off
wide length ball, driven on the up, but can't find the gap between mid-off and extra cover
bangs this in short, pulled down for a single to deep square leg
tossed up outside off, pushed to short straight extra cover
slightly short of a length, cut away to deep cover for one
slow in the air, on a length, pushed down to long-on for one
no turn this time, hits the inner half of the bat as Samad defends
well he will face only one. This is just spectacular bowling. High pace, middle stump, puff of dust, past his outside edge as Phillips plays off the back foot. The off stump is pegged back

oof. What a delivery. He has got him stumped while defending. What turn. High pace, pitched on leg, closing Markram with the angle as he looks to defend, and the ball turns away sharply. Markram is dragged out of the crease as he is not close to the pitch of the ball. Easy stumping for de Kock
on a length, at the wicket, punched to long-on
wide length ball, punched to deep cover for a single
wrong'un, on a length, punched past extra cover for two
long hop. Klaasen tucks into it. Pulls it with a straight bat over wide long-on for a big six
he has a deep midwicket in place, which sometimes gives you cushion if you bowl short, but Klaasen has placed this bang in between long-on and deep midwicket
full, just outside off, driven straight to extra cover
on a length, on off, punched to the left of Mishra, who puts in a dive and deflects the ball to extra cover
pushed through, on a length, middle and leg, punched wide of long-on
on a length, on off, pushed to long-off for a single
beaten in the air. Sees a full ball and shapes up for the big hit, but the drift into him takes the inner half of the bat to long-on
some turn, from middle and leg, runs off the front edge towards cover
low full toss, runs off the inner half of the bat for two into the leg side
wrong'un, on a length, goes back to push it to long-on for one
overpitched, and Markram is lethal when you do that. Drives it past extra cover for four
full, wicket to wicket, pushed to long-on for another single
three legbreaks in a row. Punched down to long-on
another legbreak, too short, but stays low too, which means he pulls it into the ground and to deep square leg
legbreak, on a length, punched down to long-on
what form, what confidence. A reverse sweep first ball, and he nails it wide of backward point

takes the return catch and throws the ball into the pitch. Mishra again slow in the air, has the ball on a string, nice dip, and then turn. Anmol, who has left the crease, knows he is beaten in the flight and just looks to turn it to leg for one, but gets a leading edge back to Mishra
overcompensates, and is cut away to deep point
Markram the spin hitter coming to the fore. Mishra is slow and flighting it. Looks like the wrong'un. But doesn't matter when you overpitch to Markram. He goes straight down the ground for six
too full, driven down to long-off for one
slow in the air, turn from around leg, pushed towards midwicket for one
slower ball but it is a juicy wide full toss, and he drives it between mid-off and extra cover
right in the slot, 141ks, Anmol tries to go down the ground, but the ball swings in to miss the inside edge
full again but a slower ball, driven down to long-on for one
overpitched, and Markram welcomes him with a beautiful straight drive back over his head. Crisp
on a length, at the wicket, he goes across the line and gets a single to deep square leg
short of a length, no room, pushed to mid-off
nice flight, around off, driven to deep cover for a single
pushed through, at the wicket, punched down to long-on for one
on a length, outside off, punched to cover
full, really full, nearly a yorker, dug out
too short for his pace. Anmol goes back quickly, and cuts it behind square, and beats deep point to his left
legbreak, middle and off, defended
aimed for top of off, punched back to him
short of a length, at the wicket, defended back to him

make hay when the sun shines. He missed out on a full toss last ball, and now he gets a snorter. Bouncer, at his head, 136ks, takes the top edge on the hook, and de Kock does the rest with his left hand
misses out on a knee-high full toss. Sometimes a full toss can surprise. Tripathi has just tapped it to midwicket
slower ball, wide length ball, cut away to deep point for a single
uppish flick but on the bounce to midwicket
slower ball, on a length, driven to deep point for one
just as deep point is called in, he provides him width, and Anmol square-drives it between backward point and cover-point
lovely placement. Short of a length, angling in, backs away a little, opens the face, places it between short third and backward point
slower ball, on a length, wide, steered to deep point for one
shuffles across looking for the ramp, Avesh goes short and wide, and he still ramps it but this time fine of short third for four
overpitched, 134ks, and Tripathi is waiting. Drives it through covers for four. To the right of cover and to the left of mid-off
on a length, wicket to wicket, pushed down to long-off for one
lovely shot. He has manufactured this length kinda. Presses forward early, Pandya drags the length back, and he quickly goes deep in the crease to pull this wide of mid-on
into the pads, on a length, punched to deep midwicket
slower in the air, 82ks, middle and leg, pushed wide of cover for one
short of a length, punched away to cover-point
swept away from outside off. He has gone down early, Pandya goes middle and leg, the ball turns, but he still manages to paddle it fine for four
sees him back away and bowls a wide yorker to draw a dot
finally a shot they are in control of in this over. Anmol backs away early, and upper-cuts a short ball over cover-point
half-volleys Aavesh. Another short ball, Tripathi instinctively ramps it up, and Aavesh runs in from deep third, tries his best, but can't reach it

Yudhvir is working up some steam. Right at the helmet is this bouncer. Tripathi is clearly late on the bouncer. Off the helmet it goes fine of deep third, but Aavesh makes a superb -ne-handed save to his left
short of a length, outside off, defended

he has got him with extra bounce. Or has he? Because the umpire doesn't think so. LSG say they will check with the third umpire. Excellent delivery. Not only has it kicked at him, it has also cut back a little, and taken a good chuck of the top glove on the way. The umpire has to change his decision
that's a good bouncer, gets it higher than the shoulder. Beaten on the hook
wide yorker, 128ks, right on the blue line. Gets a dot
on-pace short ball, into the body, pulled down to deep midwicket for one. It is a no-ball. The siren goes off. The back foot has cut the side crease
dug in short, no room, but Abhishek manages to upper-cut it over cover-point for four. Seems like it was the slower short ball
on a length, angling in, tucked off the pads for one
short of a length, angling in, defended back to him
gentle pace, length ball, Anmol gets a big stride in, and off-drives it on the up. Between the bowler and mid-off
on a length, on the pads, punched to deep midwicket for a couple
short of a length, no room, pushed with an open face to point
short of a length, down the leg side, called a wide. Abhishek misses out actually. Some bat, and it's four
wide length ball, drives hard at it, gets a single off the thick outside edge
full, really full, driven to mid-off
wide length ball, and he has threaded the needle. Between cover-point and cover. It is a small gap but he has found it with his cover-drive
short of a length, no room, defended back to him
That's it! LSG win the match with seven wickets to spare. Full length on legstump, flicked away to fine leg for four
Short of a length ball outside off, pulled down to wide of deep midwicket where Philips runs in a few yards and dives and stops a boundary. Unbelievable fielding again from him
Yorker on offstump, driven to long-off to keep the strike
Misses a yorker. Knee-high full toss around offstump, Pooran pulls this away to midwicket for a six
Yorker around off, digs it out to backward point. Markande puts in a dive and keeps it to one
Wide yorker this time, digs it out to point for one
Yorker on middle, drilled to long-on for one
Yorker on offstump, goes for a sweep and misses
Back-to-back fours for Pooran. Short of full length wide of off, he guides to deep point for a boundary
In the gap between backward point and point! Length around off, slices it in the gap for four
Another good yorker on middle, swipes it to midwicket for a single
Pace off. Short and wide of off, Mankad can't reach it
Yorker on middle and off, knocks it back to bowler
Full length ball wide of off, Pooran guides it to sweeper cover for one
Edges and four! Misses a yorker again. Full toss outside off, gets a top edge to third man for a boundary
Not this time. Full length on middle, Mankad watches the ball carefully and launches it over long-off for a six
Bangs in a bouncer around off, Mankad can't connect it
Full toss around off, hits it to the right of the bowler for one
Full length on middle stump, swipes it toward legside for two quick runs
Full length on middle stump, driven to long-off for one
31 runs off the over!  What an over this has been for LSG. A game-changing one? Maybe. Full length around off, goes on one knee and punish over midwicket for a six
Up, up and up, Full length around offstu,p again, Pooran goes straight and high for his second consecutive six
Starts off with a massive six! Fuller around off, pace off, bends forward and slog sweeps this over deep midwicket for a maximum
Abhishek strikes now!  Goes wide and full, it was in the slot to be hit and Stoinis looks to go over long-off only to be caught by Samad
Hugeeeee! Fuller around offstump, Stoinis picks it up cleanly to launch it straight for a six
Fuller outside legstump, wide. Hmmm, pressure?
Bam! A juicy full toss around off is dispatched over the bowler's head for a massive six.  100m
Chipped away to cover to keep the strike
That's what we want from Stoinis. Short of a length ball around off, muscled away to the left of long-on for a powerful hit
Goes for a yorker but misses just a bit. Full toss on middle, pushed to long-on and that will be fifty for Mankad
Full length around offstump, taps it to long-on for a single
Fuller on legstump, he moves across a bit to drill it to long-on
Length ball around offstump, punches down the ground to long-off
Some intent there. Full and wide of off, directs it to point and takes a risky quick single
Mistimes a sweep and the ball runs to point after a top-edge
Length ball outside off, Mankad goes back and punches it in the gap between long-on and deep midwicket
SHort and wide of off, cut away to deep cover
A slow full-length ball pitched outside off, driven to long-off
Fuller on middle, turns away a bit, he charges down and smashes it over long-on for a six
Nicely done. Length ball on middle and off, Stoinis cut it late to guide the ball in the gap between backward point and point for four
Slow bouncer from Farooqi. Signalled wide
Short ball on legstump, Mankad moves across quickly and pulls this down to deep midwicket
Drags it fuller on middle and off now, goes inside-out to whack it to wide of long-off
Short and wide of off, called wide
Short ball around off, taps it to deep cover for one
Length ball around off, knocked back to bowler
Fuller wide of off, heaves it to wide of mid-off. lands safely in the gap between mid-off and covers
Starts with a wide
Fuller on fourth stump, goes back and punches towards long-off for one
Short ball on middle and off, Stoinis goes back and pulls this to wide of long-on with not much power on it. A missed opportunity
Driven straight to point again
Full toss on legstump, reverse swept away to point
Full outside legstump, Stoinis moves across and helps it to wide of deep  midwicket where Vivrant puts in a dive to keep it to two
Fuller outside off stump, charges down to hit back to bowler
Another excellent over from Natarajan. Pace off, Full and around off, moves away, Mankad bends forward for a sweep and misses
Full length around off, drills it to deep cover for one
Another short ball from around the wicket this time, hits along the ground to the right of bowler
Bangs in a bouncer around off, Mankad throws his bat at it but misses
Short of a length ball on middle, flicks it toward deep midwicket on the back foot for one
Length ball on middle and off, angling away a bit, Stoinis looks to defend and misses
Short of a length ball wide of off, goes back and punches it toward deep extra cover
Fuller on leg stump, taps it toward deep midwicket
Yorker on middle, knocked back to bowler
Fuller outside off, Mankad charges down and lofts it toward long-on
Fuller on legstump, driven to long-on for one
Short ball, Mankad mistimes a pull this to wide of deep midwicket for two
Just short of mid-off. Fuller on legstump, lofts it toward the offside
Gets off the mark with four. Pure timing. Fuller around off, just gets it past the cover

Oh, why would you do that? Fuller on off stump, turns away a little but de Kock has already attempted a reverse sweep to that delivery, gets a top-edge and is caught by Abhishek at backward point. Markande has come back well in his second over after going for 14 in his first over
Fuller on middle, moves across and hits it straight over Markande's head for a four
Fuller outside leg stump, he moves across again and flicks it in the square leg region to keep the strike
Fuller wide of offstump, pushes to long-on for one
Full length outside legstump, he shuffles across and plays an inside-out shot to offside
Fuller on middle, flicked away to deep midwicket
Full length around off, just taps it to backward point for a quick single
Yorker on middle, lofts it to long-off for a single
Drills it to fine leg for four
Legbreak on middle, gets down quickly and brings out the slog sweep to deep midwicket to get six runs
Short and wide of off, goes back and punches to point
Full length on middle and off, attempts a reverse sweep and top edges over keeper's head
Fuller on middle stump, swept away to deep square leg for one
Short length on middle and off, goes back and punches to wide of long-on
Full length on middle and leg, outside edges to short third
Full length on middle and off, punches down to mid-off for one
Length ball around off, punches off the backfoot to sweeper cover. Philips, who slides in, can't stop it in the deep
Slower ball around off, Mankad waits for it and hits it in the gap of wide of extra cover
Almost a full length delivery around off, driven to covers
Just four runs from the over. Length ball on fourth stump, a swing and a miss from de Kock
Full length wide of off, gets a thick outside edge to third man for one
Full length around off stump, tries to push forward and misses
Excellent work in the deep by Philips. Full length around off, swept away to square leg where Philips runs in fast and saves a potential boundary
Length ball around off, cut away to deep backward point for one
Length ball outside off, looks to slice it and misses
Full outside off, driven to covers
Pace on, into the surface. Defended back to bowler
Not this time. Fuller and wide of off, driven between cover and mid-off for four
Fuller delivery outside off, hit along the ground to covers
Stunning catch from Markram! Philips strikes immediately. Full delivery on middle, Mayers lofts it towards mid-off where Markram dives to his right and completes a catch
Fuller on leg stump, hit straight to short fine leg
Short and punished! Upper-cuts this one to vacant deep extra cover for four
Length ball around off, pushed to covers
Short ball on middle, Mayers is quick on the pull but Tripathi runs in a few yards from square leg and saves a boundary
Full length around off, gets off the mark with a hit towards long-on for one
Full length on legstump, chips it to square leg for one
Length ball around off stump, defended back to bowler
Excellent over. Finishes with a yorker on middle, Mayers dugs it out to off side
Bouncer on off, Mayers swings his bat at it and misses
Full length on fourth stump, opens his arms and drives straight to covers
Length ball on middle, Mayers goes for a pull and misses. Gets hit on the thigh
Full length delivery outside off, knocked back to bowler
More swing. Length ball outside legstump. called wide
Length ball on middle stump, drills to leg side for one
Lovely. Full length delivery on middle and off, moves away just as Mayers comes down to push forward. Just 2 runs off the over
Full length delivery on middle, pushed to mid-off
Full length around off again, moves away, left alone
Full length around off, an outswinger, cuts it toward backward point where there is a little bit of misfield
Full length on middle and leg, looks to flick and misses. Going down the leg
Full length around off, moves away from the left-hander, he lets it go
